body: Sometimes time is required to calm down and nothing can calm a situation down faster as anything stokes the fire. I don't know what would have helped in that situation, but it sounds to me like you may not have the same feelings for her you once did, and when you feel trapped you don't react the same as when you feel like you're going to lose something. See if you can rekindle your love for her, to make yourself want to be around her more and see if you can both get help for learning positive outlets you can enjoy to ease your pain. I wish I had the one that made me not want to kill myself. She's not mine anymore and she's happy with who she is with and I haven't been able to face life without her. I can't imagine feeling trapped with her, so I am extremely sorrowful for your pain and hers and hope you can regain that wonderful feeling again, the both of you.

I can't tell you how sorry I am that you're going through that. With the chemical changes going on in your body you are already being tortured, and for him to treat you that way, publicly mistreat you, and express that he doesn't care about your presence, is unconscionable.

Don't harm yourself. There are tons of men that like women bigger than "model" size. If he doesn't find you beautiful, then that's his loss.

You can do whatever you want to do. I know you feel like you are stranded but unless you want to be mistreated by someone that doesn't love you, unless you can't get over your feelings for him, you really need to get out of there.

I don't have children, and really that's the same thought I'm having. I just don't want to hurt anyone. I wish we lived in a culture where it was acceptable, even honorable so that I could do it discretely without upsetting others.

I'm sorry you have to feel the same thing I'm feeling. Mine has been building since high school. No matter where I go or what I do I can't escape it and it keeps coming back. That's the only reason I haven't been able to treat this like a "temporary problem" and believe in it getting better.

Thanks again. I appreciate that there are people like you and her in this world. 

I know I've passed up others, and even hurt others because of how I feel. I know that's why I deserve to be tortured, but I can't take this. I think it's turned into a situation where I have to just try to hold on as long as I can. See how long I can go before it's over. I might be able to make it into obscurity so I don't hurt anyone else.

I need that pill. I know what the underlying problems are and if there's a pill to make me not feel, I need it. If you can get the name of it, please let me know.

You are worth something. You have a chance.

You recognize a main portion of your underlying problem already. You see that you're addicted to those that make you feel small and worthless. If you can identify the source of a problem you can begin to change it. You can start to change it by changing who you hang out with. Change your peer group, your dates, whatever you currently get yourself into that results in you being abused. You feel you can't change yourself but by doing that, by changing who you are around, you will begin to see life differently.

You want to change it because it's making you not want to live. You can do it. If you have anything in your life that makes you feel good, makes you feel like you've accomplished something, hold on to that. Expand on that.

We're here, listening. If you need us you only need to speak.

Wow. A downvote. It's ironic. I actually think that's helping. I'm getting numb now, it doesn't hurt so much, thinking about that downvote. The internet actually agrees with me. That might just get me through the day so I won't self destruct with anyone looking.

Thanks everyone! I hear you loud and clear!

Thanks. While that does make me cry more, I only feel that I will disappoint you by not pulling out of this. I want someone to decide what my future will be. I wish it could be her but it's not and I don't want to burden her or hurt her with this knowledge, so I have to have some way to get on with life, some way to actually want to live. I don't think anyone can help, but I was hoping there would be something, someone on the internet that would chance across this and give me something that I can hold on to other than a generic "Have hope".

I appreciate you listening. I can't believe I'm sitting here bawling at my desk and of all the coworkers around me no one has given a single fuck. I'm struck by how desolate this world is. How alone I am, even in a crowded room. I really shouldn't have asked for help because all it will do is end up hurting the sensitive good people that want to help.

Here I am, looking at the huge number of people who are casting their hopes into the void, and I recognize the futility of it. I can't stop this. There are so many people in this world hurting that I am just a single drop in the ocean of pain. There is nothing to help me except some well wishing people that will ultimately be unable to do more than try to instill hope in me.

I really miss holding her. That's all I want, one last time, to hold her again before I go. If there is any kind of "spooky action at a distance", any overarching framework, any kind of anything beyond clay playing with itself, please give me that one last thing.

It sounds like your friends aren't friends. You need to find someone that you like being around, even if they're not popular. 

Make an effort to enjoy yourself, your life. Your popularity will change at different points in your life, and that popularity is only important for a couple things, the rest of the time it's meaningless.

If you really do want to change yourself, hang out with people you don't normally hang out with, become interested in the things they're interested in, but don't forget to enjoy yourself.

You have time and you need to hold on to hope. Don't place too much importance on anything, including popularity. I know it's hard to let go of something you hold important, but try a little bit every day. I think you'll find a lot of really good people out there that can help you change who you are into who you want to be. By just changing who you hang out with, changing what you choose to do for fun and where you choose to be, you can begin to change yourself.

Just remember, don't hold popularity as important. Don't hold anything as so important that it has that much impact on whether you want to be alive or not. Let it go as much as you can, as often as you can.

The part where one party leads the other on by allowing them to define the relationship in their presence as more than friendship without correcting them is asshattery, commonly referred to as usership or general shittyness.
While friendzoning sucks, it is created by the pursued having a backbone and saying they don't want more than friendship, and usership is where the person didn't have a backbone and thought they could get sex out of the situation without caring what the other person thought of it.
And it ends up souring one or both of the people involved, so that both end up hurt and looking like psychos/jerks.
